'''Min''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living in the [[Moraine Outpost|Neebray Garrison]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She asked an Imperial not to destroy a power generator on which she and other Balmorran refugees depended.<ref name="heroic">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Settling Debts|Balmora}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Min is a non-player character from the [[Star Wars video games|massively multi-player online role playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. She is voiced by [[Jennifer Hale]].
